versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI Product Canvas skill.
- Provides a comprehensive template to guide AI/ML product decisions, from problem definition to launch monitoring.
- Covers key areas: problem framing, model approach, data needs, evaluation metrics, UX, responsible AI, and quality checks.
- Includes anti-patterns and required input prompts to prevent common AI product pitfalls.
- Focuses on rigorous, user-centered, and responsible AI product development.
